delta_analysis.summary: This is the first run for OpsGrid Development with no historical baseline; all 5 critical accounts have been identified and outreach initiated successfully. The workflow demonstrates strong multi-signal detection (usage drop, inactivity, support tickets) with 100% autonomous execution success, establishing a solid foundation for future pattern comparison.

outcome.situation_summary: All 5 accounts are CRITICAL with churn scores ranging from 85-100. VoltDesk (MRR $10,711) leads urgency with a -67.6% DAU drop and NPS=2. Combined MRR at risk is $17,315. Immediate CSM outreach and CRM tasks are required across all accounts.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 5 accounts with 5 critical and 0 at-risk. Primary risk patterns: usage drop >50% (2 accounts), complete inactivity 43+ days (1 account), and high support ticket volume 14/30d (1 account). Compound risk detected in 1 account combining usage drop + open tickets. All 5 critical outreach emails successfully queued for CSM follow-up. MRR range $292-$10,711 indicates churn risk spans all account sizes. Autonomous workflow execution at 100% success rate with zero escalations required.
